mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM un_flow_action a JOIN un_flow_instance f ON f.id = a.instance_id AND f.started_by_account_id = a.acted_by_account_id JOIN un_core_event_outbox e ON e.aggregate_type = 'BUSINESS_ACTION' AND a.idempotency_key = CONCAT('business-action:', e.aggregate_id) WHERE a.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND a.action_code = 'START'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO un_core_idempotency_record (context_key, operation_code, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, response_code, lock_expire_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{contextKey}, #{operation}, #{key}, #{hash}, 'PROCESSING', #{claim}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM un_core_event_outbox WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM un_core_idempotency_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM un_flow_instance WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT c.id FROM un_core_idempotency_record c JOIN un_core_event_outbox e ON e.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.response_json, '$.outboxId')) AS UNSIGNED) JOIN un_flow_instance f ON f.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.payload_json, '$.flowInstanceId')) AS UNSIGNED) WHERE e.aggregate_type = 'BUSINESS_ACTION' AND e.event_type = 'BUSINESS_ACTION_APPROVAL_REQUESTED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.response_json, '$.status')) = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND f.status IN ('COMPLETED','REJECTED','WITHDRAWN','TERMINATED','RETURNED') ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 50
